newsitem.title: INDIA: Explosion in Indian capital kills at least eight.
newsitem.headline: Explosion in Indian capital kills at least eight.

text.p: At least eight people were killed and nine injured when an explosion ripped through an apartment building in the Indian capital, authorities said on Tuesday.

The blast occurred in the three-storey building in east Delhi at 10.15 p.m. (1645 GMT) on Monday, a policeman said. One of the flats was used for making motorcycle helmets and had chemicals on the premises, United News of India said.
The police official said eight people were killed, but the Press Trust of India (PTI) said 11, including five children, had died.
Nine injured, some in critical condition, were taken to hospital, police said.
Local news agencies initially said the explosion was triggered by a gas cylinder in one of the flats, but police said they were investigating the cause.
"The exact cause of the explosion is not known," the police official said.
The explosion damaged seven houses and destroyed a car, PTI said.
Police and rescue workers were still clearing debris on Tuesday morning and the death toll could rise, authorities said.
